# Cncf Kubekey Reviewer

Review Kubekey using its official documentation and repository in the Platform / Certified Kubernetes - Installer category. Kubekey provides a flexible, rapid and convenient way to install Kubernetes only, both Kubernetes and KubeSphere, and related cloud-native add-ons.  It is also an efficient tool to scale and upgrade your cluster.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
